gloss: single item; a la carte; individual product

definitions.gloss: single item, a la carte, individual product
definitions.explanation: An individual item sold or ordered separately, not as part of a set, combo, or bundle. Commonly used in restaurants and retail contexts.

examples.japanese: {単品|たんぴん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I order it a la carte?

examples.japanese: ⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{単品|たんぴん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Ordering individually is more expensive than the set.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単品|たんぴん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まとめ{買|が}い→まとめ買い：08046_matomegai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{得|とく}→お得：07739_otoku⟧です。
examples.english: This product is sold individually, but buying in bulk is a better deal.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単品|たんぴん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧ (order a la carte)
- {単品|たんぴん}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (individual item price)
- {単品|たんぴん}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (selling items individually)

USAGE:
In restaurants, {単品|たんぴん} means ordering dishes individually rather than as a set meal (⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ or ⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧). In retail, it means purchasing a product on its own rather than as part of a bundle or pack. Contrasts with ⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (set/combo) and ⟦まとめ{買|が}い→まとめ買い：08046_matomegai⟧ (bulk purchase).
